classifiedFinding.title: Declared event RateUpdated is never emitted

classification.assetImpact: None. Dead event declaration; off-chain observability gap.
attackPath: 1. Indexers register the RateUpdated event from the ABI.
2. No emit; rate transitions are invisible on-chain.

classifiedFinding.justification: Pure spec-deviation QA. Either remove the declaration or emit at every rate update.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-low. Classifier agrees: QA.
